bio.text: Eugene Douglass is the Republican candidate for North Carolina's 2nd Congressional District in 2026.
In a 2024 News & Observer candidate questionnaire, republished on his campaign newsletter, he listed his occupation as consultant and his experience as a college chemistry professor.

He listed degrees from The King's College, the University of Connecticut and NC State University, and said he ran for U.S. Senate in Hawaii in 1998 and 2000 and for New Hampshire's 2nd Congressional District in 2002.
